sloka: अविज्ञाय फलम् यो हि कर्म त्वेवानुधावति ।स शोचेत्फलवेLआयाम् यथा किम्शुकसेचकः ॥२-६३-९॥
transliteration: avijñāya phalam yo hi karma tvevānudhāvati ।sa śocetphalaveLāyām yathā kimśukasecakaḥ ॥2-63-9॥

translations.english: Without foreseeing the fruits of his action, he who runs after action only will regret at the time of fruition like the one who waters the palasa tree.
